intro: Transpose helps you host, dine, or relax—without switching furniture. With a lift-top table that adapts like a dream and hidden storage, it’s function and finesse in motion.

features.title: One table, many moods
features.text: Go from lounging with coffee to dining with ease—its lift-top lets the table adapt as fast as your day does.

features.title: Lifts easy, locks firm
features.text: A smooth-lift mechanism glides into place and locks securely, so you always feel stable when setting down a plate or laptop.

features.title: Storage tucked below
features.text: Keep essentials—coasters, books, even devices—within reach but out of sight, thanks to the hidden shelf below.

features.title: Texture that elevates the room
features.text: Our premium wood grain finish adds quiet richness to your space, pairing effortlessly with various styles.

features.title: Big on utility, small on space
features.text: With a compact footprint, our fits into smaller living rooms while offering functionality you’d expect from a much larger piece.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Transpose Engineered Wood V2 Coffee Table
